title: Canadian Lasagna
description: A hearty and comforting lasagna dish with a Canadian twist, featuring maple-glazed ham and a blend of cheddar and mozzarella cheese.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add diced onions and cook until translucent.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add tomato sauce and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer and let cook for 5 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine shredded cheddar and mozzarella cheese.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of tomato sauce on the bottom.
Arrange 4 cooked lasagna noodles on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the cheese mixture over the noodles.
Add sliced maple-glazed ham on top of the cheese.
Repeat the layers: tomato sauce, noodles, cheese mixture, and ham.
Top the final layer of noodles with the remaining cheese mixture.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let the lasagna rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
